structure.unit: Vacancies in Elected Constitutional and Local Offices

law.catch_line: Appointees to qualify and give bond in thirty days
law.text: All officers appointed to fill vacancies shall qualify and give bond, if bond is required, within thirty days after their appointment in like manner as provided in §§ 15.2-1522 and 15.2-1523 for the qualification of such officers when elected by the people.
